clips.title: The story
paras: In Auberdine, Terenthis prepares to help find Volcor, a night elf lost in Darkshore. He can weave a camouflage cloak to protect the searcher, but needs pelts from the coast's fiercest moonstalkers.

Terenthis in Auberdine fears for Volcor and his companion, Grimclaw, as danger closes around the coast of Darkshore. The southern wilds hold aggressive predators and corrupted wildlife. Rather than send an unprotected scout into that danger, Terenthis plans a cloak woven with wild illusions.

Ordinary hides cannot confound Darkshore's beasts. Terenthis needs fine pelts from mature moonstalker sires or matriarchs. These great cats roam the woodlands south of Auberdine, near the Wildbend River and toward the forested border of Ashenvale.

Moonstalker fur and nature enchantments let the finished cloak's wearer pass through hostile territory while searching for Volcor. Terenthis warns that the illusion is delicate. Strenuous activity or combat breaks the enchantment and leaves the searcher exposed.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, your skills have already helped me in my endeavor. Could I impose on you again to help Grimclaw and his master Volcor? In addition, I can craft you a magical cloak that will allow you to walk unhindered by Darkshore's creatures while you look for him.

To create the cloak, I'll need five fine moonstalker pelts from a moonstalker sire or matriarch to have enough material. The cats can be found near Wildbend River to the south, or even farther south near Ashenvale.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I can't in good conscience permit you to seek Volcor until I've crafted that cloak for you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: These will do nicely, friend. I shall set to work on the cloak immediately.
Give me a few moments, then return to me.

Oh, one more thing: after you've used the enchantment on the cloak you'll be limited in your interactions with others. If you can help it, do no more than speak to others. Much more than that could dispel the illusion.
